wall-foundation.name: Wall Foundation
wall-foundation.description: Lifts walls, gatehouses, towers and hoardings over uneven ground, and stacks for a bigger rise. Can't be hit while something stands on it.
wall-foundation.flavor: Even a wall needs a leg up.

palisade.name: Palisade
palisade.description: A wall of sharpened logs that blocks the way for everyone.

wall.name: Wall
wall.description: A solid wall of iron-banded planks that blocks the way for everyone.
wall.flavor: Fences are for neighbours. Walls are for everyone else.

gatehouse.name: Gatehouse
gatehouse.description: A fortified gate with stairs up to the wall walk. Shuts when enemies or bandits come near.
gatehouse.flavor: Grand enough to welcome guests, sturdy enough not to.

drawbridge-gatehouse.name: Drawbridge Gatehouse
drawbridge-gatehouse.description: A gatehouse on a foundation, with a bridge two tiles out from its passage. The bridge raises when the gate shuts. Needs open space under the bridge.
drawbridge-gatehouse.flavor: The welcome mat rolls up at night.

log-hoarding.name: Log Hoarding
log-hoarding.description: A gallery on the wall where troops roll logs down at enemies, knocking over everyone in their path.
log-hoarding.flavor: "Timber!" is shouted out of courtesy, usually too late.

oil-hoarding.name: Oil Hoarding
oil-hoarding.description: A gallery on the wall where troops pour boiling canola oil on enemies below.

wall-tower.name: Wall Tower
wall-tower.description: Joins walls on any side and leads up to the wall walk. Sees far through the fog, further from high ground.
wall-tower.flavor: The best view in the district, mostly of trouble.

round-tower.name: Round Tower
round-tower.description: Taller than a wall tower, with an open top for a siege machine.
round-tower.flavor: From up here, everyone's in range.

blazer.name: Blazer
blazer.description: A fire basket on a wall, burning pine resin. Archers on the wall within two pieces of it shoot fire arrows at resin puddles. Now and then one gets burned.

resin-puddle.name: Resin Puddle
resin-puddle.description: Pine resin poured on the ground or a road. Archers by a lit Blazer set it alight with fire arrows. It burns for 6 hours and hurts everyone in it, your own too.

war-banner.name: War Banner
war-banner.description: A banner standing in a corner of a wall's or tower's walk, or on the ground. Troops in the area round it hit 6% harder. Doesn't add up with another banner.
war-banner.flavor: Beavers fight better under a flag they can see.

hanging-banner.name: Hanging Banner
hanging-banner.description: A banner hung on the outside of a wall or tower. Troops in the area round it hit 6% harder. Doesn't add up with another banner.
hanging-banner.flavor: Seen from the other side of the river.

carved-totem.name: Carved Totem
carved-totem.description: A carved beaver on a pole, standing in a corner of a wall's or tower's walk, or on the ground. Troops in the area round it hit 4% harder and take 3% less damage. Doesn't add up with another totem.
carved-totem.flavor: Carved to look braver than whoever carved it.

wall-totem.name: Wall Totem
wall-totem.description: A carved beaver on a shelf, hung on the outside of a wall or tower. Troops in the area round it hit 4% harder and take 3% less damage. Doesn't add up with another totem.

shield-rack.name: Shield Rack
shield-rack.description: A rack of shields standing in a corner of a wall's or tower's walk, or on the ground. Troops in the area round it take 8% less damage. Doesn't add up with other shields.

hung-shields.name: Hung Shields
hung-shields.description: Spare shields hung on the outside of a wall or tower. Troops in the area round it take 8% less damage. Doesn't add up with other shields.
hung-shields.flavor: Grab one on the way up.

field-infirmary.name: Field Infirmary
field-infirmary.description: A healing tub on wheels for after a battle. Once no enemy is in sight, wounded troops take turns lying in it and heal fast while its doses last. Its crew only moves it.
field-infirmary.flavor: The tub's warm. Don't ask what's in it.

field-ladder.name: Field Ladder
field-ladder.description: Lets your troops and carters climb a one-level step.

field-ramp.name: Field Ramp
field-ramp.description: A long timber ramp up a one-level step for troops, carters and siege machines.
field-ramp.flavor: Ladders are for beavers. Battering rams need something gentler.

battering-ram.name: Battering Ram
battering-ram.description: Batters the wall, gate or dam in front of it, faster with more troops aboard.

siege-tower.name: Siege Tower
siege-tower.description: Rolls up to a wall and lets the troops aboard out onto its walk.
siege-tower.flavor: Stairs took beavers to the next level. Siege towers take them to someone else's.

catapult.name: Catapult
catapult.description: Hurls stones at a chosen target, hurting enemies and battering walls and siege engines.

ballista.name: Ballista
ballista.description: Shoots heavy bolts flat and far: deadly to enemies, weak against walls.

trebuchet.name: Trebuchet
trebuchet.description: Hurls siege stones at a chosen target, hurting enemies and battering walls, gates and siege engines. Needs troops aboard to turn and throw.
trebuchet.flavor: What goes up must come down. Preferably on them.

weaponsmith.name: Weaponsmith
weaponsmith.description: Makes weapons, shields and ballista bolts.
weaponsmith.flavor: Every beaver can chew. Only a few can temper steel.

TransputProviderSpec

arms-workshop.name: Arms Workshop
arms-workshop.description: Makes swords for warriors, battle axes for berserkers, and muskets on Archipelago maps.
arms-workshop.flavor: Blades on one wall, barrels on the other.

components.name: TransputProviderSpec

gunsmith.name: Gunsmith
gunsmith.description: Makes arquebuses and blasting charges, and muskets on Archipelago maps.
gunsmith.flavor: Measure the powder twice. Then step back.

components.name: TransputProviderSpec

barracks.name: Barracks
barracks.flavor: Beavers were made for chewing, not fighting. These ones chew angrily.

archery-range.name: Archery Range
archery-range.description: Trains its workers to shoot from a distance.
archery-range.flavor: A beaver with a bow is still a beaver. A beaver with a bow and a grudge is an archer.

monastery.name: Monastery
monastery.description: Trains monks. Instead of fighting, they convert enemy troops and siege machines to your side, then wait for their faith to return.

wagon-yard.name: Wagon Yard
wagon-yard.description: Sends supply carts to the front so troops can eat, drink and build siege engines off the roads.
wagon-yard.flavor: An army marches on its stomach.

stone-press.name: Stone Press
stone-press.description: Presses scrap metal and logs into siege stones for catapults and trebuchets.

components.name: TransputProviderSpec
TransputProviderSpec

small-armory.name: Small Armory
small-armory.flavor: Spears go point up. Someone learned that the hard way.

medium-armory.name: Medium Armory
medium-armory.flavor: Half of any war is knowing where the swords are.

mine-workshop.name: Mine Workshop
mine-workshop.flavor: Workers here are asked to sneeze outside.

mine-slipway.name: Mine Slipway
mine-slipway.description: Releases floating mines that drift with the current and explode on contact.
mine-slipway.flavor: Rivers have always carried gifts downstream. Not always nice ones.

moored-mine.name: Moored Mine
moored-mine.description: A mine anchored in the water. Explodes on contact.
moored-mine.flavor: Out of sight, out of mind, out of boat.

fireship-dock.name: Fireship Dock
fireship-dock.description: Launches boats packed with explosives that sail up the river and explode on contact.

mine-net.name: Mine Net
mine-net.description: Floats in the river and catches drifting mines. Lay several end to end to make a barrier.
mine-net.flavor: The catch of the day, handled very gently.

net-winch.name: Net Winch
net-winch.description: Its worker rows out to the linked nets and brings back caught mines for reuse.

cog.name: Cog
cog.description: Sails between islands. Build it at a Shipyard, then send it to another island's coast to land there.
cog.flavor: “Grandpa sailed to the far island once. He came back with a hat and never said where he got it.” – Little Drizzik

shipyard.name: Shipyard
shipyard.description: Builds ships. Place it on a shore with its dock in the shallows, then place a ship on the dock. Its workers also repair damaged ships that come back to it.
shipyard.flavor: Beavers have been building things that float for ages. This is the first one meant to.

war-catamaran.name: War Catamaran
war-catamaran.description: Carries troops across the sea. Build it at a Shipyard. Once crewed, send it to another island's coast to land them.
war-catamaran.flavor: “It's two boats tied together, and it has never once tipped over.” – Shipwright Mirelle

paddle-frigate.name: Paddle Frigate
paddle-frigate.description: Carries troops across the sea. Build it at a Shipyard. Once crewed, send it to another island's coast to land them.
paddle-frigate.flavor: The wind takes days off. The boiler doesn't.

trade-post.name: Trade Post
trade-post.description: Ships moored by it trade goods. Choose what it buys and sells and what each good is worth: ships on a trade route will stop here. Build it on a shore with its pier in the water.
trade-post.flavor: “Everything has a price. Mine is higher.” – Bramwick the Haggler

barge.name: Barge
barge.description: A cargo boat with a big open hold. Build it at a Shipyard.
barge.flavor: Whatever doesn't fit gets tied on top.

sun-lounger.name: Sun Lounger
sun-lounger.description: Beavers stretch out here in the sun. Build it on a beach.
sun-lounger.flavor: “Ten more minutes, then I'll go gnaw something. Promise.” – Lazy Pelloo

watchtower.name: Watchtower
watchtower.description: Claims the land around it while its brazier burns, so other players can't build there. Reaches further from high ground. Sends an automation signal while enemy troops are on its land.
watchtower.flavor: From up here, it all looks like ours.

muster-post.name: Muster Post
muster-post.flavor: A log in each paw, and off they go.

power-exchange.name: Power Exchange
power-exchange.description: Sells power from one district's network to the district across the border.

resin-igniter.name: Resin Igniter
resin-igniter.description: Built on a resin puddle. Sets the puddle alight when its input turns on.

trading-post.name: Trading Post
trading-post.description: Trades goods with the district across the border. Each side picks what it buys and sells, and what each good is worth.
trading-post.flavor: A fair price is whatever both sides of the river agree on.

flamethrower.name: Flamethrower
flamethrower.description: Burns the horde in a cone in front of it, using up extract as it fires. Short range, deadly to zombies.

toll-tube-station.name: Toll Tube Station
toll-tube-station.description: Lets your beavers ride another district's tubeway for a toll.

components.name: TransputProviderSpec

toll-station.name: Toll Station
toll-station.description: Lets your beavers ride another district's ziplines for a toll.
toll-station.flavor: Mind the gap, pay the beaver.

trip-wire.name: Trip Wire
trip-wire.description: Build two and join them with a wire. Sends a pulse when someone crosses it: enemies, allies, only yours, or anybody. Both ends send it.
trip-wire.flavor: Nobody sees it. Everybody finds it.

troops-counter.name: Troops Counter
troops-counter.description: Counts your troops that are ready, in training, deployed, fighting or wounded. In district mode, it counts the troops of the district's barracks and ranges, wherever they are.
